title: Arriving in New York and living over Minton's Playhouse
summary: He describes coming by bus, staying at the hotel by Minton's, and hearing Lester Young, Don Byas, Monk, Kenny Clarke and others, with Teddy Hill as owner.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: I don't want to get quite to Boston yet, given how important New York was to become to you, I think we should spend a little bit of time on when you first came to New York. That was really your first trip to New York, right?
Yeah. It was my first trip to New York and of course Minton's Playhouse was the place, you know what I mean. Everybody was there...
Do you remember the first day you came to the City...how you came and who you were with?
We came in on a bus and I went and stayed at that hotel right next to Minton's,

what is the name of that hotel? Anyway, all the musicians stayed there and anyway I went right into the hotel, then Minton's was right downstairs. And that was just right for me. Boy oh boy, I'd come downstairs every night and Lester Young would be blowin' and Harold ("Doc") West and, oh gee whiz, Don Byas and I got a chance to really hear all these wonderful people and see them in this New York setting, you know what I mean, and it was just wonderful. And of course Kenny Clarke and Monk and, let's see, Eddie Davis was around there at the time and then he eventually became house band there. And Teddy Hill, you know, used to have a band in the Savoy years ago and he had all those guys in there...Roy (Eldridge). Chu Berry and what not and he even took a band to Europe, Teddy Hill did. Yeah. So he was the owner of the place. He used to play saxophone. So it was the place to be, you know, because you got the owner was a musician, saxophone player, and it was a place for musicians and that was just like being in heaven, you know. I learned something new every night.
Did you play any dates with Earl Hines here in the city when you first came?
